name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Combine.two_query_label_release
title: Decomposable label release: two decryptions (all-zero and all-one witness) yield both labels of every input wire at every use
statement: If a public procedure extracts from E(w) the label g i u (E w) = L i u (w i) of input wire i at use u, then for every i, u, b the label L i u b is obtained from one of the two inputs w = all-false and w = all-true.
